unit.title: A plan that survives the rain
canDo: Coordinate a shared plan and backup venue
State what changes and what stays fixed
Share preparation and costs without assigning everything to one person

grammar.purpose: Use an accepted fact as the basis for a decision
grammar.explanation: 既然 presents a fact both sides can accept; 就 introduces the consequent decision. A merely hypothetical future condition is better introduced with 如果.

examples.zh: 既然大家都能来，我们就定周六吧。
examples.py: jì rán dà jiā dōu néng lái , wǒ men jiù dìng zhōu liù ba .
examples.en: Since everyone can come, let’s choose Saturday.

examples.zh: 既然下雨了，我们就在室内见。
examples.py: jì rán xià yǔ le , wǒ men jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .
examples.en: Since it’s raining, let’s meet indoors.

commonMistakes.wrong: 既然明天也许下雨，我们已经确定下雨了。
commonMistakes.right: 如果明天下雨，我们就在室内见。
commonMistakes.why: A possible future condition is not an established fact.

grammar.purpose: Keep a result constant across alternatives
grammar.explanation: The first clause supplies alternatives or a question-word range. 都 states the unchanged result. This pattern does not erase practical exceptions unless the speaker actually includes them.

examples.zh: 无论下不下雨，我们都四点见。
examples.py: wú lùn xià bù xià yǔ , wǒ men dōu sì diǎn jiàn .
examples.en: Rain or no rain, we’ll meet at four.

examples.zh: 不管谁先到，都在门口等一下。
examples.py: bù guǎn shéi xiān dào , dōu zài mén kǒu děng yī xià .
examples.en: Whoever arrives first should wait a moment at the door.

commonMistakes.wrong: 无论下雨，我们都四点见。
commonMistakes.right: 无论下不下雨，我们都四点见。
commonMistakes.why: 下雨 alone is not a range or pair of alternatives here.

grammar.purpose: State the unwelcome consequence of not doing something
grammar.explanation: The first clause gives the action or condition; 否则 introduces what happens if it is not met. It often fits a warning or reminder.

examples.zh: 先告诉大家换了地方，否则有人会走错。
examples.py: xiān gào sù dà jiā huàn le dì fāng , fǒu zé yǒu rén huì zǒu cuò .
examples.en: Tell everyone the venue changed or someone will go to the wrong place.

examples.py: zǎo diǎn chū fā , fǒu zé huì chí dào .
examples.en: Leave early or you’ll be late.

commonMistakes.wrong: 先告诉大家换了地方，否则他们就知道了。
commonMistakes.right: 先告诉大家换了地方，否则有人会走错。
commonMistakes.why: Knowing the new venue follows informing people; it is not the consequence of failing to tell them.

grammar.purpose: Perform an action on someone’s behalf
grammar.explanation: 替 identifies whose task you take over or whom you help. It does not by itself mean the person gave you permission to make unrelated decisions.

examples.py: nǐ tì wǒ mǎi diǎn shuǐ guǒ , xíng ma ?
examples.en: Could you buy some fruit for me?

examples.py: tā tì tóng shì shàng le yī tiān bān .
examples.en: She covered a day of work for her colleague.

commonMistakes.why: 替 plus the person goes before the action.

dialogue.title: 下雨也能聚在一起
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 周六去公园的事，你问过大家了吗？
lines.py: zhōu liù qù gōng yuán de shì , nǐ wèn guò dà jiā le ma ?
lines.en: Have you asked everyone about going to the park on Saturday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 问了，现在四个人都能来。还是下午四点见？
lines.py: wèn le , xiàn zài sì gè rén dōu néng lái . hái shi xià wǔ sì diǎn jiàn ?
lines.en: Yes, all four can come. Shall we still meet at four in the afternoon?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以，不过天气预报说可能下雨。
lines.py: kě yǐ , bù guò tiān qì yù bào shuō kě néng xià yǔ .
lines.en: That works, but the forecast says it may rain.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 既然这样，我再找个室内的地方。你的活动室能借吗？
lines.py: jì rán zhè yàng , wǒ zài zhǎo gè shì nèi de dì fāng . nǐ de huó dòng shì néng jiè ma ?
lines.en: In that case, I’ll look for an indoor place too. Could we borrow your activity room?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我问问。不管下不下雨，时间都不变，对吧？
lines.py: wǒ wèn wèn . bù guǎn xià bù xià yǔ , shí jiān dōu bù biàn , duì ba ?
lines.en: I’ll ask. The time stays the same whether it rains or not, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。今天晚上尽快告诉我，我好发消息给大家。
lines.py: duì . jīn tiān wǎn shang jǐn kuài gào sù wǒ , wǒ hǎo fā xiāo xī gěi dà jiā .
lines.en: Right. Let me know as soon as you can tonight so I can message everyone.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 吃的东西谁准备？上次你一个人做太多了。
lines.py: chī de dōng xi shéi zhǔn bèi ? shàng cì nǐ yī gè rén zuò tài duō le .
lines.en: Who’s getting the food ready? Last time you did too much on your own.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这次每个人带一道菜。我带面包，你替我买点水果行吗？
lines.py: zhè cì měi gè rén dài yī dào cài . wǒ dài miàn bāo , nǐ tì wǒ mǎi diǎn shuǐ guǒ xíng ma ?
lines.en: This time everyone brings a dish. I’ll bring bread. Could you buy some fruit for me?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。买完把钱告诉你，我们四个人一起分。
lines.py: xíng . mǎi wán bǎ qián gào sù nǐ , wǒ men sì gè rén yì qǐ fēn .
lines.en: Sure. I’ll tell you what it cost, and we’ll split it among the four of us.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。费用包括水果和饮料，自己做的菜就别算了。
lines.py: hǎo . fèi yòng bāo kuò shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào , zì jǐ zuò de cài jiù bié suàn le .
lines.en: Good. We’ll split the cost of fruit and drinks, but not the dishes people make themselves.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我买完再来帮你布置，别又一个人忙。
lines.py: nà wǒ mǎi wán zài lái bāng nǐ bù zhì , bié yòu yī gè rén máng .
lines.en: Then I’ll help you set up after shopping. Don’t do everything alone again.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。这次我只负责带面包，以及提醒你别迟到。
lines.py: zhī dào le . zhè cì wǒ zhǐ fù zé dài miàn bāo , yǐ jí tí xǐng nǐ bié chí dào .
lines.en: I know. This time I’m only in charge of bringing bread—and reminding you not to be late.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A four-person gathering with shared food
A public cooking competition
A cancelled trip abroad
questions.answer: A four-person gathering with shared food

choices: Fruit and drinks
Every homemade dish
Only bread

questions.q: Why look for an indoor place too?
choices: The weather forecast suggests rain
Nobody likes the park
The time has already been postponed

reading.title: 下雨也能聚在一起
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 星期六的天气比预报的还差。三点半，我看见窗外下着大雨，赶紧问群里是不是要取消。
lines.py: xīng qī liù de tiān qì bǐ yù bào de hái chà . sān diǎn bàn , wǒ kàn jiàn chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ , gǎn jǐn wèn qún lǐ shì bú shì yào qǔ xiāo .
lines.en: Saturday’s weather was even worse than forecast. At half past three I saw heavy rain outside and quickly asked the group whether we should cancel.

lines.zh: 林安回复说：“不用取消，我们改在活动室见，还是四点。门口有一把伞，谁先到谁先用。”
lines.py: lín ān huí fù shuō : bù yòng qǔ xiāo , wǒ men gǎi zài huó dòng shì jiàn , hái shi sì diǎn . mén kǒu yǒu yī bǎ sǎn , shéi xiān dào shéi xiān yòng .
lines.en: Lin An replied, “No need to cancel. We’re meeting in the activity room instead, still at four. There’s an umbrella at the door; whoever arrives first can use it.”

lines.zh: 我到的时候，陈宇已经把桌子布置好了。桌上除了水果和饮料，还有每个人自己做的菜。
lines.py: wǒ dào de shí hou , chén yǔ yǐ jīng bǎ zhuō zi bù zhì hǎo le . zhuō shàng chú le shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào , hái yǒu měi gè rén zì jǐ zuò de cài .
lines.en: When I arrived, Chen Yu had already set the table. Besides fruit and drinks, it held dishes each person had made.

lines.zh: 大家先吃东西，后来把桌子搬到一边，一起玩游戏。四个人当中，只有我不懂规则，他们就先玩了一轮给我看。
lines.py: dà jiā xiān chī dōng xi , hòu lái bǎ zhuō zi bān dào yī biān , yì qǐ wán yóu xì . sì gè rén dāng zhōng , zhǐ yǒu wǒ bù dǒng guī zé , tā men jiù xiān wán le yī lún gěi wǒ kàn .
lines.en: We ate first, then moved the table aside and played a game together. I was the only one of the four who didn’t know the rules, so they played a round to show me.

lines.zh: 水果和饮料一共花了一百四十块。我们按四个人分，每人三十五块。陈宇说钱不用急着转，回家以后有空再转就行。
lines.py: shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào yī gòng huā le yī bǎi sì shí kuài . wǒ men àn sì gè rén fēn , měi rén sān shí wǔ kuài . chén yǔ shuō qián bù yòng jí zhe zhuǎn , huí jiā yǐ hòu yǒu kōng zài zhuǎn jiù xíng .
lines.en: The fruit and drinks cost 140 yuan altogether. Divided among four people, that was 35 each. Chen Yu said there was no rush to transfer it; we could do it after getting home.

lines.zh: 后来，一个朋友临时要回去照顾孩子，先走了。我们没把她留下，也没因为少了一个人就提前结束。
lines.py: hòu lái , yī gè péng you lín shí yào huí qù zhào gù hái zi , xiān zǒu le . wǒ men méi bǎ tā liú xià , yě méi yīn wèi shǎo le yī gè rén jiù tí qián jié shù .
lines.en: Later, something came up and one friend had to go home to look after her child. We didn’t make her stay or end early just because one person had left.

lines.zh: 那天没有去成公园，但我没有失望。大家根据天气换了地方，也把准备工作分开承担了，谁都没忙得吃不上饭。
lines.py: nà tiān méi yǒu qù chéng gōng yuán , dàn wǒ méi yǒu shī wàng . dà jiā gēn jù tiān qì huàn le dì fāng , yě bǎ zhǔn bèi gōng zuò fēn kāi chéng dān le , shéi dōu méi máng de chī bù shàng fàn .
lines.en: We didn’t get to the park that day, but I wasn’t disappointed. We changed venue because of the weather and shared the preparation, so nobody was too busy to eat.

questions.q: How did the gathering turn out?
choices: It moved indoors and still worked well
It was cancelled before anyone arrived
Everyone stayed outside in the rain
questions.answer: It moved indoors and still worked well

questions.q: How much does each person owe for fruit and drinks?
choices: 35 yuan
140 yuan
70 yuan

questions.q: Why does the narrator see the preparation as successful?
choices: The work was shared and everyone could eat
One host did all the work without eating
No food or drinks were purchased
questions.answer: The work was shared and everyone could eat

extraReadings.title: Just a little bread
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你再三说别迟到，自己怎么还没到？
lines.py: nǐ zài sān shuō bié chí dào , zì jǐ zěn me hái méi dào ?
lines.en: You kept telling us not to be late. How come you’re not here yet?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我到楼下了，面包太多，电梯还坏了。
lines.py: wǒ dào lóu xià le , miàn bāo tài duō , diàn tī hái huài le .
lines.en: I’m downstairs. There’s too much bread, and the lift is broken.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不是说只带一点吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì shuō zhǐ dài yī diǎn ma ?
lines.en: Didn’t you say you’d only bring a little?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 买的时候饿了，越买越多。
lines.py: mǎi de shí hou è le , yuè mǎi yuè duō .
lines.en: I was hungry while shopping and kept buying more.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 别爬楼了，我下来替你拿一半。
lines.py: bié pá lóu le , wǒ xià lái tì nǐ ná yí bàn .
lines.en: Don’t start climbing. I’ll come down and carry half for you.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你带把伞，门外雨可大了。
lines.py: nà nǐ dài bǎ sǎn , mén wài yǔ kě dà le .
lines.en: Then bring an umbrella. It’s really raining outside the entrance.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。今天谁都不许说“就一点”。
lines.py: hǎo . jīn tiān shéi dōu bù xǔ shuō jiù yī diǎn .
lines.en: Okay. Today nobody’s allowed to say “just a little.”
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 等你看到面包再说吧，的确不少。
lines.py: děng nǐ kàn dào miàn bāo zài shuō ba , dí què bù shǎo .
lines.en: Wait until you see the bread. There really is quite a lot.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What practical problem holds up the friend?
choices: Too much bread and a broken lift
They have lost all the food
They are at the wrong park
questions.answer: Too much bread and a broken lift

questions.q: What does the other friend offer?
choices: Carry half the bread upstairs
Cancel the meal immediately
Buy even more bread first

lines.en: This email gives the time, place and what to bring.

lines.zh: 我们早点走，否则会赶不上车。
lines.py: wǒ men zǎo diǎn zǒu , fǒu zé huì gǎn bù shàng chē .
lines.en: Let’s leave early or we’ll miss the train.

lines.zh: 先把名字写好，否则容易拿错。
lines.py: xiān bǎ míng zi xiě hǎo , fǒu zé róng yì ná cuò .
lines.en: Label the names first or people may take the wrong thing.

lines.zh: 她临时有事，今天来不了。
lines.py: tā lín shí yǒu shì , jīn tiān lái bù le .
lines.en: Something came up, so she can’t come today.

lines.zh: 我们找了一个临时放行李的地方。
lines.py: wǒ men zhǎo le yī gè lín shí fàng xíng lǐ de dì fāng .
lines.en: We found a temporary place for our luggage.

lines.zh: 请尽快告诉我你几点能到。
lines.py: qǐng jǐn kuài gào sù wǒ nǐ jǐ diǎn néng dào .
lines.en: Please let me know as soon as possible what time you can arrive.

lines.zh: 我会尽快把照片发给你。
lines.py: wǒ huì jǐn kuài bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ .
lines.en: I’ll send you the photos as soon as I can.

lines.zh: 出门前，妈妈再三提醒我带伞。
lines.py: chū mén qián , mā mā zài sān tí xǐng wǒ dài sǎn .
lines.en: Before I left, Mum reminded me several times to take an umbrella.

lines.zh: 我再三确认了地址，还是走错了门。
lines.py: wǒ zài sān què rèn le dì zhǐ , hái shi zǒu cuò le mén .
lines.en: I checked the address repeatedly and still went to the wrong door.

lines.zh: 这次活动有十位邻居参与。
lines.py: zhè cì huó dòng yǒu shí wèi lín jū cān yù .
lines.en: Ten neighbours are taking part in this event.

lines.zh: 她也想参与讨论，但还没想好怎么说。
lines.py: tā yě xiǎng cān yù tǎo lùn , dàn hái méi xiǎng hǎo zěn me shuō .
lines.en: She wants to join the discussion too but hasn’t worked out what to say.

lines.zh: 我来承担这次活动的车费。
lines.py: wǒ lái chéng dān zhè cì huó dòng de chē fèi .
lines.en: I’ll cover the transport costs for this event.

lines.zh: 他不想一个人承担所有工作。
lines.py: tā bù xiǎng yī gè rén chéng dān suǒ yǒu gōng zuò .
lines.en: He doesn’t want to take on all the work alone.

lines.zh: 这个价格包括一杯饮料。
lines.py: zhè gè jià gé bāo kuò yī bēi yǐn liào .
lines.en: This price includes a drink.

lines.zh: 参加的人包括老师和学生。
lines.py: cān jiā de rén bāo kuò lǎo shī hé xué sheng .
lines.en: Participants include teachers and students.

lines.zh: 无论下不下雨，我们都四点见。
lines.py: wú lùn xià bù xià yǔ , wǒ men dōu sì diǎn jiàn .
lines.en: Rain or no rain, we’ll meet at four.

lines.zh: 无论你选哪一件，我都觉得好看。
lines.py: wú lùn nǐ xuǎn nǎ yī jiàn , wǒ dōu jué de hǎo kàn .
lines.en: Whichever one you choose, I think it looks good.

lines.zh: 不管有几个人来，我们都准备两壶茶。
lines.py: bù guǎn yǒu jǐ gè rén lái , wǒ men dōu zhǔn bèi liǎng hú chá .
lines.en: However many people come, we’ll prepare two pots of tea.

lines.zh: 不管谁先到，都在门口等一下。
lines.py: bù guǎn shéi xiān dào , dōu zài mén kǒu děng yī xià .
lines.en: Whoever arrives first should wait a moment at the door.

lines.zh: 我们一起布置房间，准备晚上的聚会。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ bù zhì fáng jiān , zhǔn bèi wǎn shang de jù huì .
lines.en: We’re arranging the room together for tonight’s get-together.

lines.zh: 桌子已经布置好了，就差花了。
lines.py: zhuō zi yǐ jīng bù zhì hǎo le , jiù chà huā le .
lines.en: The table is arranged; only the flowers are missing.

lines.zh: 因为大雨，今天的比赛取消了。
lines.py: yīn wèi dà yǔ , jīn tiān de bǐ sài qǔ xiāo le .
lines.en: Today’s match was cancelled because of heavy rain.

lines.zh: 我不想取消，只想换一个时间。
lines.py: wǒ bù xiǎng qǔ xiāo , zhǐ xiǎng huàn yī gè shí jiān .
lines.en: I don’t want to cancel, just change the time.

lines.zh: 我们把出发时间推迟了半小时。
lines.py: wǒ men bǎ chū fā shí jiān tuī chí le bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: We postponed departure by half an hour.

lines.zh: 演出推迟到下周六了。
lines.py: yǎn chū tuī chí dào xià zhōu liù le .
lines.en: The performance has been postponed to next Saturday.

conversation.title: A plan that survives the rain
conversation.context: Rain may change the venue, but the group wants to meet at the agreed time.
conversation.goal: Coordinate a shared plan and backup venue

partner.name: 陈宇
partner.persona: A familiar classmate; friendly, brief replies.

examples: 如果下雨，我们就在活动室见。
accept: ^如果下雨，我们就在活动室见。[。！？]?$

turns.meaning: How will we divide the costs?
turns.intent: Divide fruit and drink costs among four people
examples: 水果和饮料的钱，我们四个人一起分。
accept: ^水果和饮料的钱，我们四个人一起分。[。！？]?$

turns.pinyin: yào bù yào wǒ lái bāng nǐ ?
turns.meaning: Would you like me to help?
turns.intent: Ask for one concrete piece of help
examples: 好啊，你替我买点水果吧。

natural.zh: 如果下雨，我们换到室内，时间不变。
natural.py: rú guǒ xià yǔ , wǒ men huàn dào shì nèi , shí jiān bù biàn .
natural.en: If it rains, we’ll move indoors; the time stays the same.

pragmatics.note: A venue change and a cancellation are different actions.

natural.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ ná yí bàn ma ?
natural.en: Could you carry half for me?

pragmatics.note: The bounded request makes the practical task clear.

audio.zh: 我问问。不管下不下雨，时间都不变，对吧？
audio.py: wǒ wèn wèn . bù guǎn xià bù xià yǔ , shí jiān dōu bù biàn , duì ba ?
audio.en: I’ll ask. The time stays the same whether it rains or not, right?

tasks.statement: The proposed meeting time changes if it rains.
tasks.why: The speaker asks to keep the time unchanged.

audio.zh: 水果和饮料一共花了一百四十块。我们按四个人分，每人三十五块。陈宇说钱不用急着转，回家以后有空再转就行。
audio.py: shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào yī gòng huā le yī bǎi sì shí kuài . wǒ men àn sì gè rén fēn , měi rén sān shí wǔ kuài . chén yǔ shuō qián bù yòng jí zhe zhuǎn , huí jiā yǐ hòu yǒu kōng zài zhuǎn jiù xíng .
audio.en: The fruit and drinks cost 140 yuan altogether. Divided among four people, that was 35 each. Chen Yu said there was no rush to transfer it; we could do it after getting home.

tasks.statement: Each of four people owes 35 yuan.

prompt.zh: 我一个人准备不过来，面包和水果还没买。
prompt.py: wǒ yī gè rén zhǔn bèi bù guò lái , miàn bāo hé shuǐ guǒ hái méi mǎi .
prompt.en: I cannot prepare everything alone; we have not bought bread or fruit yet.

choices: 我们分一下，你负责面包，我买水果。
面包水果都买好了，不用分工。
我们还没准备，但大家已经吃完了。
tasks.answer: 我们分一下，你负责面包，我买水果。
tasks.why: The reply divides the actual preparation tasks.

prompt.zh: 我们说下雨就改活动室，时间还是四点。现在下雨，要取消吗？
prompt.py: wǒ men shuō xià yǔ jiù gǎi huó dòng shì , shí jiān hái shi sì diǎn . xiàn zài xià yǔ , yào qǔ xiāo ma ?
prompt.en: We agreed to use the activity room if it rains, still at four. Now it is raining. Should we cancel?

choices: 不用，改在活动室见，还是四点。
不用，按刚才安排改成明天六点。
对，原来的安排是下雨就取消。
tasks.answer: 不用，改在活动室见，还是四点。
tasks.why: The backup changes venue but preserves the agreed time.

line.py: zǎo diǎn chū fā , fǒu zé huì chí dào .

line.py: tā tì tóng shì shàng le yī tiān bān .
